title: Optimize Ti2B2 monolayer structure
action: Construct the hexagonal Ti2B2 monolayer unit cell (space group P6/mmm) and perform DFT variable-cell relaxation to optimize lattice constant and atomic positions.
description: First-principles geometry optimization of the pristine Ti2B2 monolayer.

title: Compute bulk Li and Na total energies
action: Optimize bulk bcc Li and bcc Na structures using DFT and extract the total energy per atom.
description: Reference bulk energies needed for adsorption energy and voltage calculations.

title: Compute anode properties: capacity, voltage, and diffusion barriers
action: Build a 2×2 supercell of the optimized Ti2B2 monolayer; determine maximum stable Li and Na coverage via iterative adsorption calculations; compute theoretical specific capacity, average open-circuit voltage, and CI-NEB diffusion barriers for Li and Na; write all results.
description: JSON file containing the six scored battery performance metrics for Li and Na on Ti2B2.
output_schema: Object with keys: Li_diffusion_barrier (eV), Na_diffusion_barrier (eV), Li_capacity (mAh/g), Na_capacity (mAh/g), Li_open_circuit_voltage (eV), Na_open_circuit_voltage (eV). All values are numbers.
